The bank credited ₹6,44,809.61 against an expected ₹7,02,626.61. 22 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00001 of ₹57,817.00, raised 13 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00001 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00001 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
